header: A cover beside what readers will learn
lead: Three or four icon points sit between the heading and the button. The cover image keeps its document proportions and is never cropped.
note: The element never locks the file. The button links straight to it, with no form in between.

takeaways.title: Up to six points
takeaways.text: Each has an icon, a title and one sentence, like the cells of a feature grid.

takeaways.title: Two to four columns
takeaways.text: Editors choose the number. The grid adapts to the space it has.

takeaways.title: Cover or none
takeaways.text: Without an image, the text fills the whole band instead of leaving half empty.

takeaways.title: Swappable sides
takeaways.text: The reverse switch moves the cover to the other side. Screen readers still read the text in the same order.

image.alternative: A white van with its rear doors open, loaded with crates.
